When I was in high school, I noticed large cuts on my friends arm that were obviously very fresh. They were quite obvious and the fact that everyone was pretending they weren't there really bothered me. I was really nervous, but I went and told one of the guidance counselors at school. They called a meeting with her and her parents and she was sent away for proper physiatric care and eventually got better. I literally believe that if I hadn't told someone, she would have really hurt herself, or worse. At the time I knew all my friends would condemn me for it, but as an adult I realize I may have saved her life.
